title: Handle validator or harness failures
purpose: Keep the failing evidence, identify the owning layer, repair only owned defects, and rerun the affected gate.
steps: Preserve the first failure identity and bounded diagnostic output.
Classify the failure as harness structure, schema/registry mismatch, documentation drift, script parse, domain contract, environment dependency, or unauthorized boundary.
Do not weaken a validator, fixture, policy, or proof claim to manufacture a pass.
Repair only files inside the declared owned scope.
Rerun the focused failing check, then rerun dependent foundation checks and git diff --check.
If the blocker is environment, credentials, review, merge, live target, or unsupported topology, stop mutation and produce a handoff with the exact gate.
outputs: repaired tracked files or exact blocker
proofCeiling: Repair evidence for the owned layer only.
